# H-Pulse

> H-Pulse is a multi-engine cultural-rule analysis application covering BaZi, Ziwei Doushu, Liu Yao, Qi Men Dun Jia, Tieban Shenshu, Da Liu Ren, Taiyi, Meihua Yishu, Vedic and Western astrology, Kabbalah, the Mayan calendar, and Numerology.

The system follows a strict workflow: Birth Input → Kao Ke (time calibration) → Independent engine execution → deterministic scenario ranking. It uses classical software, not quantum computing. Cultural interpretations are not scientifically validated predictions. Each result carries explanation traces, warnings, source grades, and a fail-closed commercial-readiness report. Individualized mortality or lifespan conclusions are excluded from public output.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Birth input, Kao Ke verification, and unified prediction results.
- [Scenario Fusion](/quantum-prediction): Deterministically ranked finite-horizon scenario view.
- [Prediction History](/prediction-history): Archive of past prediction reports for signed-in users.
